name: Cornouaille
sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Cornouaille is a Breton mythological site. It was a kingdom of Brittany famous in myth and legend. Its name and its tales mark it as a center of Celtic story.

okr.objective: Cornouaille is a famed Breton mythological kingdom.
